electerm.name: Stretch Terminal Background
electerm.description: Stretch the terminal background image to 100% instead of the default cover mode.

configs.name: autoRun
configs.label: Apply on launch
configs.description: Re-apply on every launch. This is the switch that puts the widget in electerm's auto-run list.
